rows.label: help
rows.stdout:
Terminal-first, ultra-fast code search engine

Usage: fxi [OPTIONS] [PATTERN] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  index    Build or rebuild the index
  search   Interactive search TUI
  stats    Show index statistics
  compact  Compact delta segments
  list     List all indexed codebases
  remove   Remove an index
  daemon   Start the index server daemon (keeps indexes warm for fast searches)
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Arguments:
  [PATTERN]
          Search pattern (when no subcommand is given)

Options:
  -e, --regexp <PATTERNS>
          Additional patterns to search for (-e, can be repeated)

  -p, --path <PATH>
          Path to search in
          
          [default: .]

  -A, --after-context <AFTER_CONTEXT>
          Lines of context after match (-A)
          
          [default: 0]

  -B, --before-context <BEFORE_CONTEXT>
          Lines of context before match (-B)
          
          [default: 0]

  -C, --context <CONTEXT>
          Lines of context (both directions, -C)

  -i, --ignore-case
          Case insensitive search (-i)

  -v, --invert-match
          Invert match: show non-matching lines (-v)

  -w, --word-regexp
          Match whole words only (-w)

  -m, --max-count <MAX_COUNT>
          Maximum number of results (-m), 0 for unlimited
          
          [default: 0]

  -l, --files-with-matches
          Only print filenames (-l)

  -c, --count
          Print match count per file (-c)

      --color <COLOR>
          When to use colors: always, never, auto

          Possible values:
          - always: Always use colors
          - never:  Never use colors
          - auto:   Auto-detect based on terminal
          
          [default: auto]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
